multilineUnicode.detail: native prompt argument; compared normalized human text, not echoed terminal

textRead.detail: Actual file tool result retains known UTF-8 text

toolError.detail: Actual failed native read and linked result; scripted provider observed native error response

imageReference.detail: Vibe 2.25.8 legacy read_file decodes this PNG into numbered text via read_lines_safe_async, with replacement characters. The linked native result omits the original binary carrier; its lossy text is preserved without inventing original bytes, size or digest. User image entry is checked separately.

userImageEntry.detail: Vibe 2.25.8 legacy programmatic --prompt submits a string without the TUI's image-token expansion. Installed @image remained literal in the human prompt/provider request despite supports_images=true. TUI @image entry retains its native copied-file locator and is checked separately.

noUnrecognized.detail: Unknown native records across initial and resumed turns stay explicit

resume.detail: Exited and relaunched native continue/resume; complete multiline Unicode turn remains in original stream

backfill.detail: Both manual imports compared against automatic complete native ledger

exclusions: text-file editor attachment (native UTF-8 tool read is covered)
